answer: Make each new agent post a refundable bond whose size climbs with the number of identities already tied to its funding source: a fleet pays a rising delta on every extra head, while one honest agent pays only the flat floor. Bonds rest in a public harbor escrow anyone can audit, and a proven duplicate forfeits the whole stake. On the funding graph, clones light up violet around a single wallet, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand climbing bonds instead of one.
